answer: That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate pulse derivation per key. Because the orchard nonce is published only after close, the crystal audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 170 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
